searchText: What name is "the most correct" to refer precompiled contracts? - precompile / precompiles - precompiled / (no plular) The Yellow Paper uses "precompiled contract(s)" in many places consistently, except "precompile" in one place (perhaps it should be edited), and "precompiled addresses" in another. EIP-152 uses "precompile" in its title but "precompiled contract" in its body. So in a specification I would roll with "precompiled contracts". Make sense in this context, but I want shorter term in code. In code I would use "precompile" / "precompiles", and in this case I'm confident anyone working with EVM/EVMC will know what that means. ok, thanks!
